features-grid.headline: Three disciplines, one studio
features-grid.subheadline: We don't pretend to do everything. We do these three things, and we do them with the same hands that started them.

features.title: Brand identity
features.description: Naming, logotype, type system, color, motion principles, and the brand guide that makes it survive contact with reality.

features.title: Product design
features.description: From early product thinking to shipping interfaces. We design in code with engineering, not over a wall.

features.title: Packaging & print
features.description: Physical surfaces still matter. We design unboxings, business systems, books, and the occasional pop-up shop.

features.title: Type & wordmark
features.description: Custom type design when off-the-shelf doesn't fit. Wordmarks drawn from scratch, not modified Helvetica.

features.title: Editorial direction
features.description: Voice systems, content principles, launch comms. The words a brand uses are part of the identity.

features.title: Motion & video
features.description: Brand motion principles, launch films, and the short loops that make a product page feel alive.

how-it-works.headline: A six-month engagement, run like a real partnership
how-it-works.subheadline: We embed with your team, ship in milestones, and hand off a brand that your in-house team can extend without us.

steps.title: 1. Listen
steps.description: Three weeks of conversations with founders, customers, and the team. We map what the brand is, what it isn't, and what it needs to become.

steps.title: 2. Make
steps.description: Four months of focused design work. Weekly milestones, monthly reviews, and a shared Figma where you watch the brand build in real time.

steps.title: 3. Hand off
steps.description: A brand guide your team actually reads, a working component library, and three weeks of paired sessions to make sure it lives after we're gone.

faq.headline: Questions clients ask in the first email
faq.subheadline: If yours isn't here, write anyway — we read everything.

items.question: How long is a typical engagement?
items.answer: Six months for a full brand + product system. Shorter for a focused project (packaging, identity refresh, a single product surface) — usually 8–12 weeks.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Full engagements start at €120k. Single-discipline projects start around €35k. We send a real budget after the first conversation, not a tier sheet.

items.question: Do you work with early-stage companies?
items.answer: Yes — we take on two pre-seed engagements a year at a reduced rate, often in exchange for a small equity slice. Ask if that's interesting.

items.question: Can you start next week?
items.answer: Almost never. Our calendar is usually booked 4–6 months out. The earlier you write, the better the chance of fitting your timeline.

items.question: Do you offer retainers?
items.answer: No. Retainers reward us for being slow. We work in fixed-scope engagements and recommend an in-house hire when you need ongoing design.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: Stockholm. We work remotely with clients across Europe and North America, and travel for kickoff and milestone weeks.
